resources.string: Pairing secrets are intentionally not persisted, so recovery starts a fresh QR and SAS transaction. A successful grant clears older markers for that host.

An unselected host is not copied at all. Deselecting a host also drops any host that routes through it, so what is checked is exactly what is copied.
